teja: Quick sync: proposal for 'quota-aware-redact' policy. goal: avoid sending cleartext on tiny-sample routes while reducing over-redaction on high-traffic routes.

ana: TLDR idea?

teja: compute pii_confidence server-side, then combine with route_sample_rate. Rule: if sample_rate < 0.001 -> force pseudo/redact. else apply confidence buckets: >=0.9 full redact, 0.6-0.9 pseudonymize, <0.6 allow cleartext to sampled inspector.

mike: safety asks: inspector cleartext must be encrypted, only in short-lived store, and require two approvers to retrieve. also emit metric unredacted_sampled_count per-route.

sec-bot: reminder: any cleartext retention requires audit trail + KMS encryption per policy.

ana: console needs a small 'what-if' calc: estimate unredacted_count and token-savings if we flip route policy. PMs will want numbers.

teja: rollout: feature-flag, internal 100% 48h, then 5% external canary 48h, then 25% 24h, auto-rollback on any inspector spike or unredacted_sampled_count > threshold.

mike: implementation note: keep tenant salt in KMS and rotate monthly; keep prior-salt map for 14d for debug correlation.

ops-bot: "canary-deploy started: quota-aware-redact canary=qa-17947 (5%)"

anteja: I'll draft RFC + console mock tomorrow. thanks.
